baseline: monuments_before.json snapshot of the issue's 421 records (147 years, 140 photos).

conflicts.new_photo_description: Charlie Chaplin statue by Ranko Petrić, revealed 1983 in front of Kinoteka
conflicts.resolution: photo accepted; existing year retained; year conflict not silently merged

manual_review.false_year_candidates: Own-article candidates for Meštrović and five Stepinac statues refer to other galleries or spomen collections, not the mapped works. Same-name list candidates were likewise rejected where creator, location or work type disagreed.
manual_review.photo_candidate_bytes_and_local_images: Every one of the eight applied candidates has a decoded, resized local image plus the original Commons page and licence metadata.

method.existing_photo_rule_note: Existing text-search images are labelled legacy_commons_text_search_before_work31; they are not represented as new P18/category/geosearch results.
method.photos: Direct work P18 / OSM file / specific Commons category → complete name-or-sculptor anchored 30 m Commons geosearch. Open licence, usable attribution, page URL, image MIME, subject review, and <=400 kB local 1280 px thumbnail are required.
method.unnamed_subject_rule: Unnamed work may use only explicit linked-work labels, linked subject labels, or an explicit co-located named-work alias. A personal subject QID is never copied into the work's wikidata field.
method.years: Audit originals → Wikidata/OSM/tag evidence → reviewed hr Wikipedia list exact-year rows → own-work Wikipedia pages. No guessing, ranges, circa dates, or life-span years.

reason_summary.copyright_policy: Non-open, absent/ambiguous Cc attribution, wrong subject, portrait and map/plan candidates stay empty.
reason_summary.year_policy: Ambiguous biographies, same-name buildings/graves, other creators' works, date ranges and unsupported years stay empty.

scope: Years and licensed photos only; work31 outputs; no renderer, app-code, production data or PR changes.

renders.method: Every kind has a NOMINAL shape and a per-kind geometry in web/monument-forms.js; statues and busts take one of four forms chosen from the record. makeMonuments instances one mesh per form, so all 421 records draw with or without a photo, and the card draws the map mesh offscreen at 512x384 (web/monument-preview.js).
